SELECT f.channel_code, f.channel_id, o.fulfilment_type, o.status, p.category='ZZ Test' AS is_test, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) d_id, COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id*1000+f.line_no) d_key, MIN(f.sale_date) mn, MAX(f.sale_date) mx, COUNT(o.web_order_id) n_match, MIN(f.etl_loaded_at) l1, MAX(f.etl_loaded_at) l2
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE s.store_id=900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5 ORDER BY 1,2,3,4,5

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, fulfilment_type,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, w.fulfilment_type, f.net_amount AS net_sales, 'booked_web' AS ret_scope
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, w.fulfilment_type, -r.refund_net, CASE WHEN rs.store_id = 900 THEN 'booked_web' ELSE 'booked_store' END
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
    JOIN dim_store ss ON ss.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_store rs ON rs.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE ss.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period,
  SUM(CASE WHEN fulfilment_type='click_and_collect' AND ret_scope='booked_web' THEN net_sales END) cc_A,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ret_scope='booked_web' THEN net_sales END) web_A,
  ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN fulfilment_type='click_and_collect' AND ret_scope='booked_web' THEN net_sales END)/SUM(CASE WHEN ret_scope='booked_web' THEN net_sales END),2) share_A,
  ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN fulfilment_type='click_and_collect' THEN net_sales END)/SUM(net_sales),2) share_B_all_returns,
  ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN fulfilment_type='click_and_collect' AND net_sales>0 THEN net_sales END)/SUM(CASE WHEN net_sales>0 THEN net_sales END),2) share_before_returns
FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 6 AND 8
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2
